reaction: propanoic acid + pentan-1-ol <=> pentyl propanoate + water
batch_response: Printed acid conversion from Lorenzo and Ortega (2026) SI Table S2
primary_kinetics: Fit a mass-specific reversible rate at each setpoint. Fix apparent Kx to the matching 2:1 batch result in 2026 main Table 2. Share one mass-specific rate across all four loadings at 40 C.
batch_sensitivity: Fit a pooled smooth temperature dependence of both the mass-specific rate and apparent Kx using only the batch observations.
fit_weighting: Each printed observation with t > 0 has unit weight. Time-zero values specify the initial condition.
bed_response: Experimental acid conversion markers from Lorenzo et al. (2025) Figure 3c and Supporting Information Figure S1. Hold out every marker from parameter estimation.
bed_reference_model: Exact steady plug flow, 6 g uniform catalyst inventory and the same apparent mass-specific bead kinetics as in batch.
bed_mixing_sensitivity: Moment-match the independently simulated aqueous blue-dextran pulse-free relative variance to a Danckwerts axial Peclet number. Apply this same dimensionless number at all reaction flow rates as a scenario.
